stories.headline: Norfolk Southern freight train derails in Newark, hitting a garbage truck and injuring 2
stories.summary: Two empty rail cars left the tracks on Doremus Avenue around 3 a.m. Monday, knocking down a utility pole and pinning a garbage truck against a FedEx truck; the garbage truck's two occupants had minor injuries, and the cause isn't yet known.

stories.headline: Eileen Laubacher declares victory over Lauren Boebert in the CD4 race
stories.summary: Democrat Eileen Laubacher has declared victory over Rep. Lauren Boebert in Colorado's 4th Congressional District, which includes Douglas County and is the state's most Republican-leaning district.

stories.headline: California voters defeat billionaire tax proposal
stories.summary: Voters rejected a one-time 5% tax on most of billionaires' total wealth, a proposal that split Democrats.

stories.headline: No. 5 Michigan State takes on No. 2 Duke in the Champions Classic Tuesday
stories.summary: The Spartans, coming off a 91-61 win over Toledo, face the Blue Devils in Chicago on Tuesday night.

breadth.label: Percent of S&P 500 stocks above 50-day MA
breadth.note: Below 30 bullish, above 70 bearish. Computed by Thaddeus from Yahoo Finance daily closes for 501 of 503 current S&P 500 constituents at the Nov. 9 close (mimics MMFI). Breadth jumped from 61.5% and now sits just under the 70 line.

fear_greed.commentary: Fear & Greed rose to 32 (fear) from 22 on Friday's reading and 24 a week ago, but remains well below 44 a month ago as the rebound is still tentative.

markets.summary: Stocks rallied hard Monday as oil fell and tech rebounded: the S&P 500 gained 2.35% to 7,549.94, its best day since April 8, the Nasdaq rose 2.74% to 25,253.14 and the Dow jumped 1,104 points to 52,389.75. Small caps led with the Russell 2000 up 3.15% to 2,840.81, now above its 40-week average. Nvidia was the exception, falling 4.3% to $178.67 as its board investigates CEO Jensen Huang. The 10-year Treasury yield held near 4.86% ahead of Tuesday's October CPI report, with traders pricing about an 82% chance of a December Fed hike. Gold futures rose 1% to $4,114.50 and silver futures 1.5% to $52.56, helped by a softer dollar and a drop in crude to $86.85, though both remain below their 40-week averages.

stories.headline: Nvidia falls 4% as board probes CEO Jensen Huang over alleged Chinese spy ties
stories.summary: Nvidia closed down 4.27% after its board opened an independent investigation into reports that Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort; he apologized to staff for an affair, and the board says it has confidence in him.

stories.headline: Why Nvidia stock was down today
stories.summary: Motley Fool notes the probe won't change this quarter's numbers but House committee chairs want a closed-door briefing Nov. 18, adding long-term uncertainty.

stories.headline: SpaceX, Rocket Lab blast higher as NASA hands out $10 billion in moon base awards
stories.summary: SpaceX rose 5.81% to $142.07 as one of eight providers in NASA's lunar delivery contract pool, extending Friday's 8.6% jump.

stories.headline: Why SpaceX stock popped on Monday
stories.summary: Stifel reiterated a Buy and $190 target, and Starship Flight 15 is scheduled for Friday.

stories.headline: SPCX rises as SpaceX advances $24B Texas data center and gas plant plans
stories.summary: A Starbase public hearing on tax abatements for the roughly $24 billion project is set for Dec. 9.

stories.headline: Paradigm Capital upgrades Cameco to Buy, lowers target to C$130
stories.summary: The upgrade came Monday with a target cut from C$150 to C$130, after Cameco's weak third-quarter results.

stories.headline: Cameco renews $1 billion at-the-market share program
stories.summary: The company renewed an ATM program through Dec. 2029 and filed a US$3 billion shelf, which creates potential dilution.

headlines.headline: Dow surges 1,100 points, Nasdaq climbs more than 2% as tech rebounds
headlines.summary: Falling oil prices and a tech rebound gave the S&P 500 its best day since April 8; the Dow is back above its Election Day close.

headlines.headline: Gold, silver advance as dollar weakens, Fed rate expectations face inflation test
headlines.summary: Metals rose on a softer dollar and lower crude ahead of Tuesday's CPI, with about 82% odds of a December rate hike.

stories.summary: Denver and Littleton have sued Bow Mar to stop planned gates on a public road, saying they would push traffic onto side streets not built for it.

stories.headline: Rep. Thomas Massie files impeachment articles against Defense Secretary Hegseth
stories.summary: The articles accuse Hegseth of high crimes and misdemeanors, including waging war against Iran in violation of the War Powers Resolution.

stories.headline: Supreme Court lets border wall construction continue in west Texas
stories.summary: The justices granted the administration's emergency request to keep building near Big Bend while a lawsuit over the plan proceeds.

stories.headline: France accuses Iran of cyber sabotage on store refrigerators
stories.summary: French officials say Iranian military hackers seized refrigeration controls at about 700 retail sites last month, raising temperatures overnight and spoiling large amounts of food.

stories.headline: Short-handed MSU men's soccer falls to Maryland in Big Ten quarterfinals
stories.summary: The fourth-seeded Spartans' Big Ten Tournament run ended Sunday with a quarterfinal loss to Maryland.

stories.summary: Satire: an office worker's out-of-office reply announces an open-ended trip to the Zelda kingdom.

stories.summary: Satire: the Bee lists other dishes that might have tempted the biblical brother beyond a bowl of stew.

stories.summary: Satire: the action star comes to partway up the world's tallest building.

weather.summary: An upper low feeding on Gulf moisture keeps showers and storms over south and south-central Texas, with a Slight Risk of excessive rainfall and flash flooding in the Hill Country. A train of Pacific systems brings rain and high-elevation snow to the Northwest, and quick showers cross the lower Great Lakes and interior Northeast; elsewhere it's mostly dry and mild to unseasonably warm this week after one more frosty night in eastern North Carolina and southeast Virginia.
